item.title: Asking Strangers About Their Complicated Love Lives
item.description: Tokyo Sims takes on dating, flirting, friend zones, and some very complicated relationships in this collection of street interviews. From someone flying 12 hours to meet an online connection to “just friends” sharing a hotel room, the answers get increasingly awkward.

item.title: Would You Let Someone Bite You for $1 Million?
item.description: Tokyo Sims asks whether someone would accept a painful bite for a million dollars, and the conversation immediately spirals into chaos. Somehow, it ends with unexpected declarations of love.

item.title: I Was Not Expecting Her to Answer That
item.description: A question about dating preferences quickly leads to a very candid response during this Tokyo street interview. Things only get more awkward when the follow-up questions start.

item.title: Her Plan If She Gets Cheated On Is Wild
item.description: Tokyo Sims asks what she would do if she caught her partner cheating, and she already has a plan. The conversation then shifts to awkward situations, where her strategy is surprisingly simple: just let the awkwardness continue.
